description: Realized volatility, change over window, and range for an instrument, computed over its stored history. Use this for 'how volatile is X' and 'how has X moved over the last year' — it answers both in one call, so prefer it over fetching price.history and computing yourself. Descriptive only: no signals or view, which live in decision.get.

code.description: Instrument code from catalog.list. Example: CC, CL, GC.

windows.description: Windows to compute over, as a count and a unit. Example: ["30d", "90d", "1y"]. Defaults to those three.

name: price.stats

as_of.description: Economic date of the newest observation used

change.description: Change across each window, both endpoints dated

input_series.description: The window these figures were computed over. Dereference via price.history for the observations themselves.

license_tag.description: Licence the derived figures may claim

periods_per_year.description: Observations per year implied by the series cadence; null when the cadence makes no promise and nothing can be annualized

range.description: Min, max and mean over the retained history

annualized_pct.description: Null when the window cannot support a figure

title: Price Statistics
